listing.name: Peerless Skills
listing.summary: Offers Lv 3 Piloting skills for your character, just like before 0.95 when Alex cruelly took them from us. Miss you, 15% CR on piloted ship only.
listing.aiSummary: Adds Level 3 Piloting skills to the character skill tree.

description:
Peerless Skills v0.1
Offers Lv 3 Piloting skills for your character, just like before 0.95 when Alex cruelly took them from us. Miss you, 15% CR on piloted ship only.

Download | All fourteen skill effects

Training

Open Intel > Contacts > your character's Peerless training contact.

Completing the Galatia questline grants one Peerless point. Main story line of Hall of Triumph and Sea of Stars also grant one point each for completing their main stories.

Optional post-cap XP progression is off by default. Enable it through LunaLib to earn additional points with XP after the skill cap.

notes

SiC compatible

Safety Overrides and Field Modulation: Field Modulation cancels an SO ship's first overload. It does not clear flux or bypass SO's no-vent restriction.

Phase Anchor and Combat Endurance: excess damage can trigger both Phase Anchor and Combat Endurance at the same time.

There is a rare crash bug if you rapidly upgrade and reassign peerless skills then esc out of the skill screen. Hard to reproduce. I think I fixed it.
